title: Strong yet Controllable LLM Abstention without Learning to Abstain
abstract: arXiv:2610.16318v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can reduce hallucination by abstaining from questions they would likely get wrong. Abstention can be implemented outside the model (selective answering) using a confidence threshold that controls the answer rate (coverage), or learned inside it (abstention training), which can perform better but fixes coverage once trained. To compare the two, we match their coverage and decompose risk (error rate) into answering ability and distinguishing ability, i.e., how well the model answers and how accurately it abstains, respectively. The decomposition shows that abstention training performs better mainly by answering better: with strong confidence estimators, the two have nearly equal distinguishing ability. translated_title: 无需学习弃答的强效且可控的大语言模型弃答方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以通过对其可能答错的问题进行弃答来减少幻觉。弃答既可以在模型外部实现（选择性回答），即使用置信度阈值来控制回答率（覆盖率），也可以在模型内部学习（弃答训练），后者性能可能更好，但一旦训练完成，覆盖率便被固定。为了比较这两种方法，我们在匹配二者覆盖率的前提下，将风险（错误率）分解为回答能力和区分能力，即模型回答问题的能力以及准确进行弃答的能力。这一分解表明，弃答训练之所以表现更好，主要是因为其回答能力更强：在使用强置信度估计器的情况下，两者的区分能力几乎相当。这启发我们提出了“先训练准确性，再事后选择”（Train for Accuracy, then Post-hoc Select，TAPS）方法，这是一种模块化方法，能够保持覆盖率可控，只需标准的后训练和一个现成的置信度估计器，并且可以受益……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 论文通过分解弃答的风险发现弃答训练的优势主要来自更强的回答能力而非区分能力，据此提出TAPS方法：只需标准后训练加上现成置信度估计器进行事后选择，即可达到与弃答训练相当的性能，同时保持覆盖率可控。
en_tdlr: The paper decomposes abstention risk to show that abstention training's advantage mainly comes from better answering ability rather than distinguishing ability, and accordingly proposes TAPS, which combines standard post-training with an off-the-shelf confidence estimator for post-hoc selection, achieving comparable performance to abstention training while keeping coverage controllable.
